hebrewText: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר מִלְא֨וּ אַרְבָּעָ֤ה כַדִּים֙ מַ֔יִם וְ/יִֽצְק֥וּ עַל הָ/עֹלָ֖ה וְ/עַל הָ/עֵצִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁנוּ֙ וַ/יִּשְׁנ֔וּ וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר שַׁלֵּ֖שׁוּ וַ/יְשַׁלֵּֽשׁוּ

tokens.bdb: properly, a pail; but generally of earthenware; a jar  for domestic purposes
water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
properly, to pour out (transitive or intransitive); by implication, to melt or cast as metal; by extension, to place firmly, to stiffen or grow hard
tokens.kjv: cast, cleave fast, be (as) firm, grow, be hard, lay out, molten, overflow, pour (out), run out, set down, stedfast.
